Yes — damaged items are handled differently from normal returns.
Normal returns: Once an order has been delivered, returns are generally not accepted for change of mind or taste preferences. 
Damaged items: If something arrives broken or incorrect, you can report it within 7 days of delivery. You’ll need to provide:
• Your order number
• A short description of the issue
• Photos of the damaged item and the packaging
You should also keep the item in the condition you received it while the situation is reviewed. 
So damaged shipments are treated as a shipping issue, not a standard return.
